text_en: Upon my bed at night I sought him whom my soul loves; I sought him, but found him not; I called him, but he gave no answer.
text_cn: 夜间我在床上，寻觅我心爱的；我寻觅，却没有找着。

text_en: “I will rise now and go about the city, in the streets and in the squares; I will seek him whom my soul loves. ” I sought him, but found him not.
text_cn: 我遂起来，环城巡行，在街上，在广场，寻觅我心爱的；我寻觅，却没有找着。

text_en: The sentinels found me, as they went about in the city. “Have you seen him whom my soul loves? ”
text_cn: 城里巡夜的卫兵，遇见了我，我便问道：“你们看见我心爱的吗？”

text_en: Scarcely had I passed them, when I found him whom my soul loves. I held him, and would not let him go until I brought him into my mother’s house, and into the chamber of her that conceived me.
text_cn: 我刚离开他们，就找着了我心爱的；我拉住他不放，领他到我母亲家中，到怀孕我者的内室。

text_en: I adjure you, O daughters of Jerusalem, by the gazelles or the wild does: do not stir up or awaken love until it is ready!
text_cn: 耶路撒冷女郎！我指着田野间的羚羊或牝（pìn）鹿恳求你们，不要惊醒，不要唤醒我的爱，让她自便吧！

text_en: What is that coming up from the wilderness, like a column of smoke, perfumed with myrrh and frankincense, with all the fragrant powders of the merchant?
text_cn: 那从旷野上来，状如烟柱， 发放没药、乳香以及各种舶来香料香气的，是什么？

text_en: Look, it is the litter of Solomon! Around it are sixty mighty men of the mighty men of Israel,
text_cn: 看，撒罗满的御轿，有六十勇士环绕，全是以色列的精旅，

text_en: all equipped with swords and expert in war, each with his sword at his thigh because of alarms by night.
text_cn: 个个手持利刃，善于战斗，腰间各佩刀剑，以防夜袭。

text_en: King Solomon made himself a palanquin from the wood of Lebanon.
text_cn: 撒罗满王用黎巴嫩香柏，制造了一个宝座，

text_en: He made its posts of silver, its back of gold, its seat of purple; its interior was inlaid with love. Daughters of Jerusalem,
text_cn: 银柱金顶，紫锦垫褥，中间绣花，是耶路撒冷女子爱情的结晶。

text_en: come out. Look, O daughters of Zion, at King Solomon, at the crown with which his mother crowned him on the day of his wedding, on the day of the gladness of his heart.
text_cn: 熙雍女郎！出来观看撒罗满王，他头戴王冠，是他母亲在他新婚心灵欢乐之日，给他戴上的。
